data.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Mary S. Sabol's Poetry Collection on Trauma and Mental Health
data.description: Palmetto Publishing has recently launched a book titled Innermost Moods, featuring raw confessional poetry reflecting personal struggles with trauma, depression, and resilience. The book was released in Charleston, S.C. on September 15, 2026. This collection offers a glimpse into lived experiences and emotions, providing insight into the challenges faced by individuals.

data.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Victor Colon's Military Memoir The War Within
data.description: A Marine Corps veteran and Bristol, Connecticut native has released his first memoir detailing his experiences overcoming bullying and poverty in housing projects, serving on combat tours abroad, and grappling with PTSD. The book is now on sale through Palmetto Publishing. The author recounts his journey from his hometown to serving overseas, shedding light on the challenges faced by veterans. The memoir offers a poignant insight into his struggles with PTSD, providing a raw and honest account of his military service. The book was made available for purchase on September 15, 2026, with the author hailing from Bristol, Connecticut.

data.title: Maverick Corporation to Lead Infrastructure Installation for NYC Curbside EV Charging Buildout

Maverick Corporation is a prominent company specializing in EV Make Ready design and construction.

data.title: InventHelp Inventors Develop New Pet Gate for Garages (MBQ-911)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 15, 2026, an inventor from College Hill, Pennsylvania shared that they created the INSTA-KENNEL to provide a solution for pets to enjoy fresh air from the garage. The inventor wanted a safe and secure way for dogs or cats to look outside without actually leaving the garage. The innovative design offers a unique solution for pet owners, with a focus on safety and security in mind.

data.title: Goodwill Industries of Eastern North Carolina, Inc. (GIENC®) Launches Food Market in Eastern North Carolina Food Desert
data.description: The Goodwill Community Cupboard located in Aurora is now open, offering affordable access to nutritious food. This initiative was launched by Goodwill Industries of Eastern North Carolina (GIENC®) in Durham. The newly opened Goodwill Community Cupboard at 150 South 5th Street aims to provide healthy food options to the community at reasonable prices. This move by GIENC® signifies a commitment to addressing food accessibility issues in the area.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Suitcase with Modified Wheels (LOS-656)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 15, 2026, an inventor from Bakersfield, California shared his inspiration for creating a new suitcase concept called WHEELS UP. The inventor wanted to address the issue of damaged wheels when not in use and aimed to provide a solution. The innovative design of WHEELS UP ensures that luggage wheels are protected from damage, eliminating the inconvenience of dealing with broken wheels.

data.title: Fatty Liver Disease Early Signs Detailed in HelloNation Article Featuring Health Expert Dr. Karen Jerome-Zapadka
data.description: The report delves into the reasons behind the silent nature of fatty liver disease and highlights the importance of screening in maintaining overall liver health. The article discusses the prevalence of undetected fatty liver disease and emphasizes the significance of early detection for long-term liver wellbeing.

data.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Farzaneh's New Memoir About One Woman's Journey from Iran to Freedom
data.description: Palmetto Publishing has recently released a new book titled "Ascent," detailing the journey of an Iranian woman who went from a childhood marked by silence and religious oppression to eventually discovering her voice in the United States. This book offers an inspiring narrative of self-discovery and resilience. The publication date was September 15, 2026, in Charleston, South Carolina.
